name: Zinger Burger
description: Crispy, golden-fried chicken fillet with fresh lettuce, creamy mayo and a soft bun — the crowd-favourite for burger lovers.

name: Anda Burger (Egg Burger)
description: Classic Pakistani anda burger with a fluffy fried egg, spiced patty, onions and tangy chutney in a toasted bun.

name: Shawarma
description: Tender, marinated chicken wrapped with garlic sauce, fresh veggies and soft pita — rolled fresh for a satisfying bite.

name: Fruit Chaat
description: A refreshing medley of seasonal fruits tossed with chaat masala, lemon and a hint of sweetness — light and energizing.

name: Chana Chaat
description: Tangy chickpeas mixed with onions, tomatoes, green chutney and aromatic spices — a true street-food classic.

name: Samosa Plate
description: Golden, crispy samosas filled with savoury potato and peas, served with tangy imli chutney. Perfect for sharing.

name: Dahi Baray
description: Soft lentil dumplings soaked in creamy yogurt, topped with sweet-and-spicy chutneys and a sprinkle of chaat masala.

name: Chicken Seekh
description: Juicy, charcoal-grilled chicken seekh kebabs seasoned with traditional spices — smoky, tender and full of flavour.

name: Milkshakes
description: Chilled, creamy milkshakes blended fresh — choose your favourite flavour for a cool, delightful refreshment.
